Об этой вакансии
You sit with the business, not behind it. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you'll work side by side with our clients' teams, find the problems worth solving, and ship AI products that solve them in weeks, not quarters. Part of the job is telling clients honestly what makes sense and what doesn't, and explaining why. You own the whole path: from the first conversation with a business owner, through scoping, estimating, and budgeting the work, to a working prototype and a product in real use.

You'll have a lot of autonomy and real influence. We're looking for someone who spots opportunities, proposes solutions, and drives them forward without waiting to be told what to do.

Your tasks
Work embedded with client business teams to turn their ideas into concrete, buildable product concepts
Prototype fast, test with real users, and decide what to scale, pivot, or drop
Scope, estimate, and budget projects, including key risks and how to mitigate them
Build and ship LLM-powered products: assistants, agentic workflows, and integrations with business systems
Bring a product perspective: define success metrics, prioritize by business value, and measure real impact
Contribute to the strategy and growth of our AI business unit

Requirements
At least 4 years in software engineering, including shipping LLM-based applications that real users rely on
Pragmatic Python skills and hands-on experience with LLM APIs, RAG, tool calling, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent)
Daily, practical use of AI software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor
A product mindset: you think in MVPs, user feedback, and measurable outcomes
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders
Experience scoping and estimating software or AI projects, including effort, cost, and risk
A self-starter attitude
Advanced level of Polish and English
Residency in Poland

Nice to have
Frontend skills for quick prototypes and demos (e.g., React, Streamlit, Gradio)
Startup, product company, or founder experience
Background in a specific business domain (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector)
Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
